verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's SSO page says it enforces SSO and MFA across "all SAML and OIDC-based apps," which suggests protocol-level support beyond a fixed catalog. However, nothing explicitly documents configuring custom or non-catalog apps. A community user calls the SSO "not that bad" but had to figure most of the setup out alone. Missing for 10: explicit custom/non-catalog SAML and OIDC app connector documentation, header-based app support, step-by-step configuration walkthroughs, independent hands-on corroboration of custom app setup.
